name: Coordinator Board
description: Group agent sessions by project and answer the ones waiting for you, from a sidebar panel or a full-width dashboard tab.

cover.alt: Coordinator Board: a focus view of one pending decision above a matrix of projects and session states.

screenshots.alt: Inbox view listing decisions by urgency with the selected decision open on the right.
screenshots.caption: Inbox: every session waiting on you, most urgent first

screenshots.alt: Focus view showing a single overdue decision with a recommendation and a reply box.
screenshots.caption: Focus: one decision at a time, with J/K/S shortcuts

screenshots.alt: Matrix view with a ribbon of decisions and a table of projects by session state.
screenshots.caption: Matrix: projects against session states at a glance

screenshots.alt: A reply card with option buttons that fill the reply, plus questions and answers below.
screenshots.caption: Answer in place: options fill the reply, questions stay on the card

screenshots.alt: A coordinator's decision record with single and multiple choice questions.
screenshots.caption: Coordinator decision records with recommended options

screenshots.alt: A merge review card showing branches, reviewed HEAD, checks and merge method buttons.
screenshots.caption: Review and merge pull requests from the board
